summary: Iter13 retest of /messages multi-slot MonthBookingCalendar. All HIGH-priority items from iter12 are now PASSING. CompactWeekSchedule.jsx has been deleted; InboxPage.jsx now imports MonthBookingCalendar and renders it on homeowner threads (line ~396). End-to-end booking flow verified live in the preview env.
verified_behaviors: /messages right-rail shows [data-testid=calendar-booking] with [data-testid=cal-prev] and [data-testid=cal-next] on homeowner-with-pro thread
Days with availability render [data-testid^=cal-day-] with data-has-slots='true' and a dot marker
Clicking such a day reveals 1-hour [data-testid^=cal-slot-] buttons (verified: 09:00-10:00, 10:00-11:00 etc.)
Clicking cal-slot-09:00-10:00 then cal-slot-10:00-11:00 updates [data-testid=booking-selected-range] to '09:00-11:00 · 2h'
Selecting a non-adjacent slot (14:00-15:00) collapses selection to that single slot (text '14:00-15:00 · 1h')
confirm-booking-btn becomes enabled and POST /api/bookings is fired with a single body {job_id, pro_id, day:'Thu', slot:'09:00-11:00', date:'2026-05-28'}
After confirmation, chat shows two system bubbles: 'Appointment booked: Thu, 09:00-11:00' (Add to Calendar iCal link) AND 'Appointment: Thu, May 28, 09:00-11:00' (kind=booking message)
AttachmentUploader [data-testid=attachment-uploader] still present in the message composer (regression OK)
Cookie banner does not block calendar interactions (set via localStorage.cookie_consent='all')
critical_code_review_comments: InboxPage.jsx is 552 lines — borderline (recommendation: split out the booking calendar / contact bar / message bubbles into smaller components before it grows past 700).
bookSlot uses dateObj.toISOString().slice(0,10) which converts to UTC — for clients far from UTC the booked date can shift by one day. Consider building isoDate from local Y/M/D instead.
